fonts.title: Font Settings
fonts.override.hint: When off, the chosen font only replaces text without a book-specified font. When on, all body text uses it; code and formulas keep their original fonts.
fonts.dropHint: Supports TTF, OTF, WOFF, or WOFF2 fonts
fonts.split.hint: When on, choose a heading (h1–h6) font separately; when off headings follow body text. Override Book Fonts applies to both.
fonts.role.heading: Heading
fonts.current.heading: Current heading font: {name}
fonts.override.hint.split: When off, both fonts only replace text without a book-specified font. When on, body and headings use their own fonts; code and formulas keep their original fonts.
fonts.override.hint.short: Off: fill only missing fonts. On: force the chosen fonts on body and headings (code and formulas excluded).
